definitions.explanation: The place where something happens or happened.
The place where actual work is done.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧{現場|げんば}
⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧{現場|げんば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}けつけた→駆けつける：14632_kaketsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I rushed to the scene of the accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{現場|げんば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}していた→到着する：02526_touchaku⟧。
examples.english: The police had arrived at the scene of the incident.
To listen to voices from the field.

examples.japanese: {現場|げんば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: Companies that value opinions from the field are strong.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本社|ほんしゃ}→本社：09565_honsha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{現場|げんば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Sometimes headquarters' policies don't match the situation on the ground.

notes:
{現場|げんば} refers to the actual place where something happens or where work is done. It has two main uses: a specific location (scene/site) and the workplace front line (as opposed to management).

SENSE 1 — SCENE/SITE:
- ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧{現場|げんば}: accident scene
- ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧{現場|げんば}: crime scene
- ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧{現場|げんば}: construction site
- ⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧{現場|げんば}: filming location
- {現場|げんば}⟦{検証|けんしょう}→検証：04792_kenshou⟧: on-site investigation

SENSE 2 — FRONT LINE/FIELD:
Contrasts with ⟦{本社|ほんしゃ}→本社：09565_honsha⟧ (headquarters) or management.
- {現場|げんば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: voices from the field
- {現場|げんば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧: opinions from the front line
- {現場|げんば}⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧: site supervisor
